title: T06g — After-start health check in the update receipt
goal: Accept an update only when the started service is healthy, not just running
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; actual profiles, backups, credentials and deployment evidence remain private.
acceptance: After start, verify the running build commit, base identity, database integrity and that the brain and nervous processes answer; record the result in the receipt
A failed check leaves the operation uncertain with the ordered manual recovery, never a silent success
validation: Regressions through the real adapter with a fixture service; independent review; final required CI
escalation: Any destructive restore, changed ownership or unresolved physical/worker effects requires explicit reconciliation; general restore remains F-062

effort.basis: Owner-approved split of the original T06 (4–6 focused days) into lettered slices on 2026-11-11, after the work had been delivered as unplanned slices; slices e–h use free step numbers because step IDs are two digits. Uncertain: which health signals are reliable right after start. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one.
